title: Throughput signalization harness and customer acceptance kit for Dedicated capacity
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: deliver a reproducible, tenant-aware load testing harness and benchmark methodology that validates Dedicated capacity throughput guarantees and autoscaling policies, and produces a signed customer acceptance artifact. Scope: workload generation (replay + synthetic profiles), signal extraction (throughput, p50/90/99 latency, queue depth, GPU utilization, KV-cache hit rates), autoscaler integration tests, failure-mode checks (node loss, noisy neighbors), and an acceptance report template for customers to sign off on committed SLAs. The kit must be usable by Solutions/SEs in onboarding and by SRE/Eng for release gating.
acceptance_criteria: Bench harness can replay a customer trace (HTTP request traces in standard Redwood format) with median replay fidelity >= 92% and configurable time-scaling
End-to-end test verifies autoscaler policies: step, target, and predictive modes (where applicable) and produces deterministic scaling events for given load profiles
SLO verification: for declared Dedicated tier X, 99th percentile tail latency must be within negotiated target +/- 10% across three sustained 30-minute runs
Isolation checks: running noisy-tenant background load results in <5% degradation for the verified tenant under the default scheduler configuration
Failure tolerance: single-node loss or preemptive eviction during a sustained run triggers fallback routing without client-visible error rate >1%
Cost guardrail: harness reports estimated incremental GPU-hours and provides a conservative cost estimate per passed acceptance check
Customer acceptance artifact: auto-generated PDF with test parameters, raw metrics (CSV links), and a short executive summary suitable for customer sign-off
tasks: Design harness architecture (generator, runner, metrics collector, verifier) and document in Confluence
Implement workload generator: replay + synthetic ramp/mix profiles with token-level distribution options
Integrate with autoscaler APIs and simulate all three policy modes
Create dashboard templates (Grafana) with standard panels and alert rules for acceptance runs
Run baseline suite against internal Dedicated staging fleet and produce initial acceptance artifact
Write runbook for Solutions/SE to perform customer-facing acceptance and include checklist for security and cost approvals
